mechanism: A human-scale foreground witness establishes a remote monumental destination; a continuous camera drift leaves the witness, a distinct near-plane motion crosses the path, and a clear far-wide hold delivers the landscape.

invariants.rule: Establish a near observer against a stable distant destination.
invariants.purpose: Lets audience read the scale crossing.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without near/far contrast, the move becomes an unmotivated landscape pan.

invariants.rule: Clear the initial foreground while keeping the destination anchored.
invariants.purpose: Transfers the viewpoint from watching to entering.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the destination jumps or the observer stays dominant, the transition does not read.

invariants.rule: A separate nearer-plane motion crosses the view before the final uncluttered destination hold.
invariants.purpose: Guides eye and emphasizes layered depth.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without near-plane movement, the final wide is only another static vista.

slots.name: witness
slots.constraint: One adult or clear scale marker in near plane.

slots.name: destination
slots.constraint: One fixed monumental place with stable horizon.

slots.name: near_plane_guides
slots.constraint: Several independently moving entities with readable direction and depth.

slots.name: camera_path
slots.constraint: Smooth move past witness toward established destination.

slots.name: medium_palette
slots.constraint: Original physical setting; no copied fantasy light-animal motif.

anti_copy_exclusions: No moonlit castle, gothic silhouettes, deer, cloak, glowing wolves or source waterfall layout.
Do not invent a physical connection between the moving near-plane figures and distant architecture.
No original creator name, branding or exact panoramic composition.

instantiations.concept: At an original near-future cargo port just before dawn, an adult route engineer stands by a railing facing a gigantic suspension transfer bridge across container cranes. The camera begins behind her, then glides beyond the rail as she exits frame. Several small autonomous inspection carts cross the near pier laterally, their white work lamps tracing separate paths. Hold the unchanged huge bridge and shipping channel after the carts clear; no fantasy beasts or magical activation.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Cargo port engineer, colossal bridge, near inspection carts, clear final port vista.

instantiations.concept: At a sunlit salt-flat observatory, a solitary adult meteorologist frames a distant radio array from the lip of a low ridge. The camera glides past him. A line of wind-driven sensor kites crosses the close ground in a staggered wave, then clears to show the same array in an open wide view.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Salt-flat meteorologist, distant radio array, near sensor kites, clear final array.

failure_modes.failure: Moving guides look attached to the distant structure.
failure_modes.repair: Keep parallax and foreground occlusion separate.
Retain one landmark in all phases.
Move beyond the near rail while destination remains centered.
